items.title: Charlie De Vore Interview, 1962-07-04
items.q: Don Ewell particularly, probably things about his personality. But boy, he was a musical taskmaster and knew what he wanted.

ctx.x: You listen to them, you know that they really study it.

Yeah. Poor Mutt, he's really taken a beating through the jazz history and stuff. But he was a guy who could really play. That Ori band was really a wonderful band. They had all the things that the white musicians complain about when they hear the rougher bands. Man, they made changes, they made it all. Ori was a damn good trombone player. He was a tough guy to work for though, from all the reports that I've heard. Don Ewell particularly, probably things about his personality. But boy, he was a musical taskmaster…
I like the part he plays when all the whores like to obey our rights. Yeah. That's a beautiful part, the way they have that worked out in the band.
